changes: Use retained RenderNode row display lists on Android 10+ hardware canvases; reuse recordings when a row changes
Keep Picture recording for Android 9 and software canvases
Skip cell-background fills equal to the already-cleared view background
Re-record discarded hardware lists and release caches on geometry changes/detach
frame_pacing: Original Choreographer publication wait and animation invalidation retained. The combined scheduling experiment was not selected because it did not improve complete-frame pacing clearly.

checks: GPU image equality vs Picture at integer/fractional offsets
GPU re-record/discard recovery and actual TerminalView cache vs fresh pixels
padding seams, cursor, fonts, links, selection and pane gestures
signed non-debuggable APK, ART profiles and 16 KiB library/ZIP alignment

methodology.workload: Same two-pane 23-row colored text repaint at up to 30 Hz, four pane swipes, output restart, scroll
methodology.comparison: Sequential paired release tests on the same physical S22+; one run per version/configuration, not randomized repeated statistical trials
methodology.reported_trace: 20-second low-overhead FrameTimeline plus app-only trace markers; broad gfx tracing omitted from reported A/B to reduce compositor instrumentation overhead
methodology.trace_health: No reported data loss, errors or buffer overwrites in paired traces
methodology.limitation: Native publication-to-pixel/key-to-pixel latency and battery effects not measured; stress test is not ordinary typing

interpretation: Canvas recording is cheaper in this sample; whole-frame mean/p95 improve only modestly
Deadline-miss rate has not meaningfully improved: gfxinfo 56.90% before and 57.79% after
FrameTimeline dropped frames were zero before and one after; do not claim dropped-frame improvement
Larger whole-app smoothness and battery benefits have not been established
